feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: iteration 3 (0.10 m track, 0.6 kg, lead 0.05 m, +/-0.06 m sensors) is the best design at 493.2, with s-bend progress 0.75 and oval finish 0.85. The slalom is the only failing track, finishing 0 of 20 with max_error 0.0624 at the 0.06 m floor. Iteration 4 (0.08 m track) overshot, with s-bend oscillation 0.45 and score down to 355.9, so narrowing the track is rejected. Iteration 5 (+/-0.07 m reach) cut slalom progress to 0.15 and s-bend finishes to 0.10, so widening reach is rejected. This candidate tests mass alone. Interpret the next race as follows. If slalom progress rises above 0.34 or any slalom finish appears, and s-bend steering_oscillation stays below about 0.5, keep 0.5 kg and move to the 12 mm footprint test at the iteration-3 span. If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.5 while the slalom does not improve, return to 0.6 kg, since the lower inertia is overshooting. If the slalom is unchanged with line loss near 0 and max_error still about 0.06, the limit is controller response, so do not change geometry again and let the Integrator adjust kd or base_speed.
requested_changes: If slalom progress rises above 0.34 or finishes appear while s-bend steering_oscillation stays below about 0.5, keep mass 0.5 kg and test sensor_size 0.012 at the iteration-3 span (+/-0.06 m, 7 sensors), since iteration 5 showed the reach is adequate and the footprint is untested.

If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.5 (iteration 3: 0.44) without a slalom gain, return to mass 0.6 kg with the iteration-3 geometry, since the lower inertia is overshooting and iteration 4 showed that sharper turns raise oscillation.

If the slalom is unchanged with line loss near 0 and max_error still about 0.06 m, hold the geometry at iteration 3 and report the result, since iterations 4 and 5 showed that track and reach changes do not help the slalom, which points to the controller's kd or base_speed.
